says: The typecheck port plan's law T1 (tracker ticket 766) puts scripts/typecheck* into the .agents program, but every non-.agents file there gets TS377051 duplicatePackage, and duplicate-packages.test.ts (E3) keeps the only allowance to .agents/** globs; tsc fails on warnings.

cost: pnpm typecheck stays red on the branch until the plan picks another program for scripts/typecheck* or the owner widens E3.
